request.description: Fetch Shopify products/variants with inventory. Uses Shopify API version 2026-01.
Fetch all available Shopify locations for mapping. Call this after connecting to Shopify to see which locations are available.
Map a FLEXI location to a Shopify location. All inventory updates for this FLEXI location will use the mapped Shopify location.
Create a sale with items from both FLEXI catalog and Shopify. Automatically updates inventory for both systems.
Get full sale details including inventory updates, Shopify sync status, etc.
List all sales with pagination and filters. Returns summary (large arrays excluded)
Void a completed sale. Marks as voided with reason and audits who voided it.
Process a refund. If less than total = partial_refund, if full = voided.
Get revenue summary: total sales, revenue, tax, discount, items by catalog type, payment methods
Connect an organization to its Shopify store using client credentials (OAuth 2.0). The system will automatically fetch and refresh access tokens every 24 hours.
Checking server health and keeping server active if on free tier
Check if Shopify is connected for this organization.
Inspect retry queue items (e.g., failed inventory syncs).
View sync history for debugging (inventory updates, product fetch, webhook received).
